ENKO is a full-cycle music company from Ukraine. Distribution, publishing, marketing.

Ukraine’s largest independent music company, founded in Kyiv in 2020, with offices in Kyiv and Warsaw. We work with 170 artists, distribute through Universal Music Group, publish with Sony Music Publishing and Kobalt, and run marketing with our partner LYRA. Our artists won Eurovision in 2022 and placed top-3 in 2024.

01.1 · What we do

Distribution, marketing and publishing under one roof.

Distribution

Through our Universal Music Group partnership: all major platforms, markets worldwide, releases pitched to editors properly. A personal distribution manager who knows your record cold, and royalty reporting with every stream itemized.

Marketing

Paid campaigns on Facebook, TikTok and YouTube, a promo plan for every release, and influencer campaigns end to end. Run with our partners at LYRA. It’s the reason the numbers on this page look the way they do.

Publishing

With Sony Music Publishing and Kobalt: your works registered, tracked and collected worldwide. Legal support and strategy sessions come standard.

04 · For Business

Music as an asset.

ENKO is more than a label. We analyze the market, acquire and grow catalogs, build studios and launch venture projects with artists. Here is how to build business with us.

Investment opportunities

Catalog acquisition & evergreens

We acquire Ukrainian evergreen catalogs and grow them in three stages: acquisition, marketing test against KPIs, remarketing. Royalty revenue of the ENKO label doubled from 2023 to 2024.

Studios

Creative residency in the Carpathians, a production studio in Los Angeles and ENKO Hub in Kyiv, a full complex in development.

Venture projects with artists

Carpetman was built from zero into an international act. The model is now a service: we co-invest, run the analytics and share the upside.

Ways to work with us

Brand Deals

Artists for campaigns, launches and integrations. Two Eurovision entries and 1B+ views of reach.

Sync Licensing

Film, TV, trailers, advertising, games. One catalog, one contact, worldwide clearance through Sony Music Publishing and Kobalt.

Catalog Acquisition

We buy or manage catalogs: transparent reporting, platform optimization, sync placements.

Sublabel Partnership

Keep your brand and A&R. Use our distribution, marketing, legal and reporting infrastructure.

FAQ

What is ENKO?

ENKO is a full-cycle music company from Ukraine: distribution, publishing and marketing under one roof. Founded in Kyiv in 2020, offices in Kyiv and Warsaw, 170 artists, 19.5B+ streams.

How do I send a demo?

Email distribution@enkomusic.com with streaming links to your best tracks. Every submission is reviewed within 14 business days.

Which markets do you cover?

All major platforms worldwide through Universal Music Group, 150+ services. Active markets: Ukraine, Poland, Europe and the US.

Do you offer advances?

Yes. Advances are based on performance data and growth potential. Each deal is structured individually.

Can you help with sync and licensing?

Yes. Our publishing arm with Sony Music Publishing and Kobalt clears placements for film, TV, advertising and games worldwide.

How does a sublabel partnership work?

You keep your brand and A&R. We provide distribution, marketing, legal support and reporting.
